findings.issue: READ targets lacked pre-READ guards and sentinel-init probes
Stream POS offsets assumed one file storage unit per character

findings.resolution: Added with a connection-method feature mutant.

findings.issue: A mutant read an unwritten stream storage unit (non-conforming per 12.3.3.4 p3)
findings.resolution: Parent writes the position; mutant fails by value.

findings.issue: A mutant left POS=1 unwritten then read it
findings.resolution: Parent pre-writes POS=1; all mutant reads audited.

lesson: A mutant must stay conforming: reading a storage unit that was never written makes the program invalid, and then its failure proves nothing.
